//: NEMESIS System mod. Generates a persistent hostile NPC from the dead player's save file. The Nemesis inherits the player's stats, skills, bionics, mutations, equipment, and cause of death, then spawns in the game world after a delay proportional to how powerful the player was. SETUP: After each death run: python3 nemesis_launcher.py <path/to/character.sav>. For cold-start worlds run: python3 nemesis_seeder.py. Both scripts write JSON files into this mod directory and recompile nemesis_master.json automatically.
name: Nemesis System
description: Generates a hostile NPC from the dead player's save file. Run nemesis_launcher.py after each death.
